cwe_content.cwe: CWE-379,Creation of Temporary File in Directory with Insecure Permissions

candidate.Reason: Creates temporary directory using File.createTempFile() which uses system temporary directory with insecure permissions (world-writable on Unix systems), allowing collocated users to perform race condition attacks and potentially control the contents of generated files

cwe_content.cwe: CWE-378,Creation of Temporary File With Insecure Permissions

candidate.Reason: Creates temporary directory with insecure permissions using File.createTempFile() followed by delete() and mkdir(). This creates a temporary directory that is world-readable and world-writable on Unix systems, allowing other users on the same system to access and modify its contents, leading to potential privilege escalation attacks.

Uses the insecure temporary directory created by getTmpFolder() to store generated code files, making them accessible to other users on the same system who could potentially modify the generated code before execution.
